concepts.def: Public agreement without private acceptance; behaviour reverts when group leaves.
Conforming to a group's behaviour because membership of the group matters; partial private acceptance.
True acceptance of group beliefs both publicly and privately; permanent change.
32% mean conformity to wrong line answers; conformity fell when an ally was present or task was harder.
Stanford Prison Experiment showed rapid identification with assigned guard or prisoner roles; stopped after 6 days.
Dual-process model: normative (be liked) and informational (be right) influence explain conformity.
